SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip, f."Enrollment (K-12)", f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS diff
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > 30
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 200
